verdict.rationale: The evidence describes many single-purpose creative apps (Short Film, Product Ad, Podcast Video) and a Pika MCP server for external agents such as ChatGPT and Claude. Nothing documents a built-in AI assistant inside Pika that users can hand tasks to. The phrase "without leaving your conversation" refers to use through external MCP-compatible agents, which is an adjacent, host-side capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
